blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines is planning to deploy a liaison officer to India’s maritime information-sharing center to strengthen cooperation in monitoring activities at sea, the Department of National Defense (DND) said on Thursday. Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. committed to facilitating the deployment of a Philippine officer to India’s Information Fusion Center–Indian Ocean Region
